lore_anchors.definition: A legendary fire-element spirit bird, long extinct, that feeds on Yin spirits and ghosts. Its name refers to its oil-rich, flammable body that paradoxically makes it a natural predator of cold entities.
A refined, weaponized corpse controlled by a master. Unlike a mindless zombie, it is a durable tool for assassination and combat.
A type of Yin-attributed dark mist used by demonic or necromantic cultivators to trap, obscure, and drain their opponents.
The third major realm of cultivation. A cultivator at this stage has condensed their energy into a core, granting vastly increased lifespan and power.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why did Hu Yue's flying blade not protect him?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The blade was designed to detect "killing intent" from a living enemy, but the ambusher was a puppet corpse with no discernible killing aura, bypassing its automatic defense.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is the Zhi Yang Bird's weakness?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The scroll only contains a fragment of the bird's original spirit, so the clones summoned are far weaker than the real thing; they can only suppress, not destroy, high-level ghost fog.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why did Shi Die die so easily?
cultural_notes_faq.a: She was the weakest cultivator present and panicked, making a break for the exit alone. The ghost claw was a pre-set trap designed to punish deserters, not to fight the main party, making her an easy target.
